description: Read or set the auto-zoom framing pattern (Center's Console slider under Single/Group tracking: off/3/5/7/9/…/24). Off=normal, 7/9/16/24=P7/P9/P16/P24 (subject-size framing percentages), 3/5≈halfBody/fullBody (3 disabled in group mode). Arming AI tracking sets this to `shot` — which is why the status block's zoom_type reads shot while tracking. Writes are GATED (MEASURED 2026-10-01): the camera 500s unless human tracking is armed — obsbot_tail2_ai_track enabled:true first. Readback-verified write.
